cases.title: Original SVE · m=2, κ=0.05
equations: (h u)_t + (h u^2 + g h^2/2)_x + g h B_x = 0
cases.solver: Rusanov FV + centered bed source + SSPRK3; smooth positive branch
cases.reduction: Full PDE evolution. Cubic scaling is separately verified; these periodic data do not use that scaling.
cases.evidence: Mass/bed drift, positive depth, sampled hyperbolicity and three-grid self-convergence checks.

cases.title: Reduced SVE · κ=0.05
equations: (h u)_t + (h u^2 + g h^2/2)_x + g h B_x = 0
cases.reduction: h=x²H(t), u=xV(t), B=x²C(t); verified local chart x>0.
cases.evidence: Exact original-balance residuals vanish; numerical profiles checked against closed form. The plotted x-window is not a closed periodic domain.

cases.title: 2D NS · shear · ν=0.01
equations: u_t + u u_x + v u_y + p_x = nu Laplacian(u)
v_t + u v_x + v v_y + p_y = nu Laplacian(v)
cases.solver: Fourier vorticity + strict 2/3 dealiasing + RK4; dt<=0.01 plus CFL/diffusion bounds
cases.reduction: x-translation invariant shear; V=0, constant P reduces to the heat equation.
cases.evidence: Analytic velocity control; divergence and dissipation checks.

v_t + a v_x + b v_y + p_y = nu Laplacian(v)
